name: Wrenix of Ratchet

narrative.details:
Zando'zan has seen it! Yes, the day comes! Thrall's death... the dagger in his back, poison seeping through to his every vein... Zando'zan has said too much.

adventurer! Zando'zan has a task for adventurer! adventurer must travel to Ratchet, east of the Crossroads, and speak with Wrenix the Wretched. Go!
narrative.objectives: Travel to Ratchet and speak with Wrenix the Wretched.
narrative.offerRewardText: Another one? The last five that crazy troll sent me ended up as shark food. Let's hope you fare a little better, eh?
